$comment: Compatibility sweep round 22 list (compiled by Android compat round 25): the next 30 Chrome Web Store extensions by install count after the top 30 of round 1, the 30 of next30.json and the 30 of each of next30-round3.json to next30-round21.json (ranks 631-660; manifests under the project store internal/extensions/next30-round22/). Counts are the store detail pages' rounded figures read 2026-09-29; ties inside one rounded bucket are ordered by the page's rating count, equal rounded rating counts by name. Candidates came from the store's category listings and keyword searches, about 26,710 detail pages probed across rounds 3 to 22 (this round read the store's 20 listings and round 17's 548 search terms again - 3,272 ids, 48 new detail pages, the largest of them at 1,000 users, none at the bucket). Round 21's list took the rounded 300,000 bucket down to its last rankable items and the rounded 200,000 bucket's first 28, so every unlisted candidate at or above the rounded 100,000 bucket (689 detail pages: 26 above 600,000, 2 at 600,000, 2 at 500,000, 4 at 400,000, 5 at 300,000, 181 at 200,000 and 469 at 100,000) was read again on 2026-09-29, the day of this list's read; against the pool's stored figures sixteen user counts differ - the same sixteen round 21's list recorded (its seventeenth, Web Highlights, was ranked 621) - and the list ranks the re-read figures: up one bucket DocsAfterDark, Automation 360 and History Shortcut - Fast History Button from 100,000 to 200,000 (below the cut); down one bucket Link Grabber and SciSpace from 300,000 to 200,000 (below the cut), Extension Manager, Instant Gaming and Points Path for Google Flights from 200,000 to 100,000, and WEB.DE MailCheck, Seamless.AI, NotebookLM Tools for Gemini Notebook, Aircall Dialer, Music Mode for YouTube, Designer Tools, Meet Extension and BattleTabs from 100,000 to 70,000-90,000 (below the bucket) - and 27 detail pages published no user count on two reads (at the bucket Gale In Context: Opposing Viewpoints and Education Pro Browser Extension MV3 at 300,000, and NetSupport School Student, IntoWords Cloud, Assessment Lock (Vretta), Sophos Chrome Security, Single Sign-on Assistant and SAP Enable Now at 200,000 - organisation-managed items whose rating counts, 112 and fewer, fall below the cut in any case; the other 19 organisation-managed items, Chrome Apps or themes above it), so their stored figures stand, as round 23 ruled for such pages. The buckets at and above 300,000 hold no unlisted rankable item (the themes, Chrome Apps and organisation-managed items named below); ranks 631-660 are the rounded 200,000 bucket's next 30 items by rating count - Teal - Job Search Companion (3,200), Web Scrobbler (2,900), Ad Remover - Ad Blocker for Chrome (2,800), Block Site: Site Blocker & Focus Mode (2,800; equal rating counts, so by name), Weava Highlighter - PDF & Web (2,800; equal, so by name), StayFree (2,700), WA Bulk Message Sender (2,700; equal, so by name), ChatGPT Exporter (2,600), Dark Mode - Dark Reader for Chrome (2,600; equal, so by name), Diigo Web Collector (2,300), News Feed Eradicator (2,300; equal, so by name), Tiny Tycoon (2,300; equal, so by name), AI Sidebar for DeepSeek (2,200), Knowt (2,000), LINE Share (1,900), rikaikun (1,900; equal, so by name), Web to PDF (1,800), Google Arts & Culture (1,600), Stylebot (1,600; equal, so by name), WiseStamp Email Signature (1,600; equal, so by name), Url Shortener for Google Chrome (1,500), VPN USA - Planet VPN lite Proxy (1,500; equal, so by name), Color Tab (1,400), Toucan by Babbel (1,400; equal, so by name), ChatHub (1,300), Color Picker HEX | Eyedropper (1,300; equal, so by name), Media Harvest (1,300; equal, so by name), Mouse Tooltip Translator (1,300; equal, so by name), Super Simple Highlighter (1,300; equal, so by name) and YouTube Dual Subtitles (1,300; equal, so by name) - and the cut falls between YouTube Dual Subtitles at 1,300 ratings and Auto Clicker - AutoFill at 1,200 (SwiftRead at 1,200 beside it, then DXF Viewer, Octotree and Tab Manager Plus at 1,100). None is a wallet; Teal, Web Scrobbler, Weava Highlighter, WA Bulk Message Sender, ChatGPT Exporter, Diigo Web Collector, AI Sidebar for DeepSeek, Knowt, LINE Share, Web to PDF, WiseStamp, VPN USA, Toucan by Babbel, ChatHub and Media Harvest ask for an identity, a signed-in site or their services - ranked as earlier lists ranked Grammarly and HubSpot Sales. Google Arts & Culture and Color Tab replace the new-tab page (chrome_url_overrides.newtab); none carries chrome_settings_overrides; none is a native-messaging companion. Two rows have no background at all (Tiny Tycoon: an action popup and nothing else; Color Tab: a new-tab page and nothing else, no permissions), three carry a MAIN-world content script (rikaikun on Google Docs, Media Harvest and YouTube Dual Subtitles), three open a side panel (Teal, Knowt, ChatHub), VPN USA carries the proxy permission, Web to PDF the debugger permission, and Ad Remover, rikaikun, Media Harvest and YouTube Dual Subtitles name a minimum Chrome version (102 to 109). The rows carry the manifests' names, which match the store's listings for 29 of the 30; the store lists Mouse Tooltip Translator - PDF & Netflix Youtube dual subs as "Mouse Tooltip Translator - PDF & Netflix YouTube dual subs" (Dark Mode - Dark Reader for Chrome spells its Chrome with a Cyrillic capital es in both the manifest and the listing, and the row keeps it). Not ranked: themes (Morpheon Dark, Dark Theme for Google Chrome, Sea Foam), Chrome Apps (Google Classroom, Postman), organisation-managed or organisation-login-only items (the list of round 21's comment - ClassLink OneClick, Clever, Endpoint Verification, Mobility Print, Lightspeed Insight Agent, Okta Browser Plugin, Trellix Endpoint Security Web Control, LearnPlatform for Students, OpenText Content Server Browser Web Extension, Pix Companion, Snow Web Application Metering, My Apps Secure Sign-in Extension, MasteryConnect LockDown Browser, HID Credential Management Extension, LanSchool Web Helper, iboss Cloud Connector, RapidIdentity, Browser Security Plus, Browser Redirection Extension, ActivID CMS extension, Britannica School Insights, Idira Identity Browser Extension, Citrix Web Extension, Securly for Chromebooks, Cegid Peoplenet ClickOnce launcher, Omnissa Horizon URL Content Redirection Helper, CXone Agent WebRTC Extension, iboss Classroom Management for Students, Chrome Reporting Extension, JumpCloud Go, Education Pro Browser Extension MV3, Gale In Context: Opposing Viewpoints) and Google items whose detail pages publish no user count.
